_comment: Game Cards (rules 18). 14 types, 35 cards (18.a, Vidi 2026-10-21; Sneak Attack from the Sea! added 2026-11-07; the two Coin Master cards added 2026-11-20). `type` is "battle" or "other": only battle cards get the Battle Card label and the builder step (PLAN 5.2, 10.8). Used cards go to the Game Card discard pile (18.l).

cards.name: Elephants!
cards.text: +1 to all of your dice in odd battle rounds (1, 3, 5…). A second Elephants! in the same battle covers the even rounds instead. At most two per battle.

cards.name: Moral boost!
cards.text: +1 to every one of your dice in the round you play it. A second copy may be played in a later round.

cards.name: Revolt!
cards.text: Inspire a revolt in a province of another player (never Roma, never a province with 10 or more troops): half its minimum garrison + 1 troops die and the owner loses 1 Prestige. The owner may block it with Kill Revolt leader.

cards.name: Assassin!
cards.text: Kill up to 2 troops in enemy provinces (a held Roma too), on one province or split over two. Natives killed stay dead. A target needs 2+ troops and never drops below 1; each province only once per occupation. Unplayable (kept) with no legal target.

cards.name: Kill Revolt leader!
cards.text: Instant: block a revolt aimed at you (Revolt Roll or Revolt card), even on the turn you draw it. Does not use the 1-card-per-turn slot.

cards.name: Prestige!
cards.text: +1 Prestige. Played as soon as it is drawn, then discarded.

cards.name: Garrison Requirement -1!
cards.text: All your garrison minimums are 1 lower, never below the native count. Stays with you.

cards.name: Bribe the Ally!
cards.text: Pay Gold equal to the native troop count of a province allied against you to flip it to your side. Carthage can never be allied. Or: pay 1 Gold to turn one of your own allied provinces into a conquered province (it keeps its troops, +1 Prestige).

cards.name: Battlefield Imperator!
cards.text: Needed to attack Roma. Hold at most 1 (a 2nd draw is shuffled back and redrawn). Must be held until the turn after it was drawn. Spent when used.

cards.name: Busy Little Bee!
cards.text: Redirect a Rome Is Displeased card aimed at you onto another player of your choice (they need not qualify). Costs 1 Gold to Roma's pile. Uses the 1-card-per-turn slot.

cards.name: Horn of Titus Pullus!
cards.text: When your province is attacked, before the first roll: call reinforcements from ONE bordering province of yours (an allied one too, but from an ally only your own troops there, never its natives; no Road needed), any number of troops (no cap) leaving at least 1 behind (a held Roma keeps its 10, and Roma never goes above 20); your general may come. They fight as defenders. If the defence holds, you choose whether the survivors go back where they came from or stay. Only one Horn per battle.

cards.name: Sneak Attack from the Sea!
cards.text: Attack any province that has a sea link, from one of your coastal provinces that has a Road. The attack counts as a sea attack (2 dice; 3 with Pompey, an extra die with Scipio). It costs 1 action and no troops can be borrowed for it — move troops to the origin first. Roma still needs a Battlefield Imperator card.

cards.name: Coin Master (Selling a Card)
cards.text: Hold it as a lasting bonus; never played. Each sale of a different card pays 1 extra Gold (3 instead of 2). Selling this card itself pays only 2 Gold. No bonus on Resource card Gold.

cards.name: Coin Master (Unused Actions)
cards.text: Hold it as a lasting bonus; never played. At the end of your Actions, +1 Gold once if you have any unused action (0 actions taken = 3 Gold, 1 = 2 Gold, 2 = nothing).

cards.name: Elephant Panic!
cards.text: Play it when another player uses Elephants! in a battle. One of their Elephants! cards is thrown away into the discard pile and doesn't help them in that fight.

cards.name: Forced March!
cards.text: Play it on your turn to take 3 actions instead of the usual 2, and you may play 1 extra non-battle Game Card that same turn. Playing either card is not an action.

cards.name: Bandits on the Road!
cards.text: Play it on your turn and pick another player. You take Gold equal to their Merchant Bonus right away, and you can spend it this turn if you have actions left. That player gets no Merchant Bonus on their next turn.

cards.name: Spy in the Tent!
cards.text: Pick another player and take 1 card from their hand without looking. It's now yours.
